title: GranularFlow-Bench Schema v3 (contribution-centric)
description: Three-tier higher-order schema for structured extraction from granular flow literature. v3 replaces FUNCTION_RELATION-as-core (v2, abused on experiment papers) with CONTRIBUTION-as-reified-entity (survey-grounded: SciClaim association reification + Matter-of-Fact 2D classification). See docs/dataset-design/DESIGN-v1.md §4.

research_question.description: The paper's research question. May be inferred from title/abstract when not explicit (3/9 papers had no explicit RQ — annotation-protocol issue, not schema issue).

atoms.description: All extracted atoms across L1/L2/L3 layers.

subject.description: Entity or mention the relation points from

object.description: Entity or mention the relation points to

L3_contribution.description: A reified first-class contribution entity (NOT an edge). Per SciClaim association reification — allows multi-attribute decoration and inter-contribution relations.

statement.description: The contribution stated in the paper, as a self-contained assertion

subtypes.description: Multi-label (NOT mutually exclusive — a contribution can be experimental_finding AND supports a mechanism). Per Matter-of-Fact 2D classification.

params.description: For constitutive_law: named parameters of the law (e.g. mu_s, mu_2, I_0)

evidence.description: Source sentence/figure reference supporting this contribution

L3_contribution_relation.description: Directed edge BETWEEN contributions. Per HyperRED hyper-relational structure — the relation (esp. conflicts) can carry a qualifier. Per MAGIC — conflicts are first-class graph structure, not post-hoc detection. v4: added applies_in_regime/specializes/generalizes/bounds_applicability_of — granular flow 'competition' is regime-complementary (not contradiction, per expert review).

qualifier.description: Condition/regime/range under which this relation holds (e.g. 'in the dense regime')

L3_closure.description: Optional: structured multi-variable constitutive relation (e.g. mu(I)=mu_s+...). Only for papers with explicit constitutive laws. Coexists with CONTRIBUTION (text statement) — CONTRIBUTION describes what, CLOSURE describes the structured function. Added v4: v3's params field could list param names but couldn't express input/output/function-form coupling (confirmed by rheology diagnosis).

statement.description: Human-readable description of the closure relation

function_form.description: The functional expression (text or LaTeX, e.g. 'mu(I) = mu_s + (mu_2-mu_s)/(1+I_0/I)')
